how: a second model with its own prompt (greening_check_v1: one label, the deciding quote and a reason), in a fresh process with tools, connectors and project files off, shown each contract's own text; it never saw the first reader's answers

7.label: weak
7.note: Local green spaces and the greening of block interiors and façades are framed only as what the neighbourhood "doit" (must) receive, a stated need or priority, with no commitment verb that plans or finances a change to vegetation cover.
7.quote: Le quartier de la rue Marie-Christine doit prioritairement bénéficier d'investissements qui permettront : une suppression des friches urbaines réinvesties par des bâtiments et des espaces verts de proximité.

45.label: yes
45.note: The contract lists this among the projects it carries out ("développe les projets suivants"), so it commits to rehabilitating and greening a square and the streets around it, which changes vegetation cover.
45.quote: réhabiliter et végétaliser le square Jacques Frank et les voiries qui l'entourent

46.label: yes
46.note: The contract lists laying out a park among the projects it carries out ("développe les projets suivants"), which is a firm commitment to create a green space.
46.quote: intervenir sur les espaces publics: réaménagement d'une place et d'un carrefour, aménagement d'un parc

47.label: no
47.note: The closest candidate restructures an inner-block space around a youth centre, a playground and a crèche, but never mentions vegetation or unsealing, and the other public-space work (pavements, roads, squares, lighting) and façade renovation are not greening measures either.
47.quote: restructurer un espace et un intérieur d'îlot autour d'un centre de jeunes, d'une plaine de jeux, d'une maison de l'enfance et d'une crèche

48.label: yes
48.note: The contract lists planting in public spaces among the projects it carries out ("Il développe les projets suivants"), and it also plans urban vegetable gardens on the Plaine de Liverpool, so it commits to changing vegetation cover.
48.quote: intervenir sur les espaces publics: plantation, réfection de façades, trottoirs et voiries

49.label: yes
49.note: The contract lists creating a small public garden among the projects it develops, which is a firm commitment to a new green space; it also plans planting in public spaces.
49.quote: créer un petit jardin public et une fresque murale

52.label: yes
52.note: Planting in public spaces is listed among the projects the contract says it carries out ("développe les projets suivants"), so it commits to changing vegetation cover.
52.quote: intervenir sur les espaces publics: éclairages, plantations et réfection de voiries

54.label: yes
54.note: Laying out a park is one of the projects the contract says it carries out ("développe les projets suivants"), so it is a firm greening commitment, not just an aim.
54.quote: aménager un parc, des plaines de jeux et des espaces de rencontres

55.label: no
55.note: The only greening-looking word is "Parc" in a street name, and the planned public-space works (renovating pavements, colourful squares with street furniture, semi-pedestrian roads) include no planting, paving removal or green-space creation.
55.quote: Les îlots situés entre l'avenue du Parc et la chaussée d'Alsemberg sont inclus dans le périmètre

56.label: yes
56.note: The contract lists this among "les projets suivants" it develops, so planting in public space and creating a park system are planned measures that change vegetation cover, not just aims.
56.quote: renforcer le maillage vert par des plantations dans l'espace public et en créant un « park system »

57.label: yes
57.note: The contract lists the redesign of green spaces as one of the projects it "va développer" (will carry out), alongside planting urban vegetable gardens, so it commits to changing vegetation cover.
57.quote: assainir et réaménager les espaces verts aux pieds des logements sociaux

58.label: yes
58.note: The contract says it "va développer" (will develop) projects that include turning a green wasteland into a linear park and setting up community vegetable gardens. That is a firm plan to create a park and gardens.
58.quote: aménager une friche verte, le tracé historique de la Senne, en un parc longitudinal formant un couloir de mobilité active entre le quartier Masui et le centre-ville

59.label: yes
59.note: This is one of the projects the contract says it "va développer", so it commits to greening the inside of several housing blocks, and it also plans to plant at school entrances and green façades.
59.quote: activer et verduriser plusieurs intérieurs d'îlots

60.label: yes
60.note: The contract says it "va développer" (will develop) a set of projects, and one of them is laying out a new 3,200 m² park inside the block. It also commits to a green axis that raises soil permeability by 10–20%, so it clearly commits to changing vegetation cover.
60.quote: aménager un parc de 3.200 m2 en intérieur d'îlot, entre les rues Potagère, du Moulin et de la Limite

61.label: yes
61.note: This greening of a square and several streets is listed under "Les actions prévues", so the contract commits to it; the same list also includes redesigning the Parc Petit Scheut.
61.quote: verduriser et restaurer la Place Desmet ainsi que plusieurs voiries (rues de l'Agrafe, de l'Aguille, Ruquoy et Verdonck, etc.)

64.label: yes
64.note: The list comes after "Le contrat de Quartier Durable va développer ... les projets suivants", so creating gardens inside the housing blocks is a planned project, and new gardens change vegetation cover.
64.quote: développer le pôle « petite enfance » rue Van Dyck: crèche passive, local de « co-accueil » (accueil d'enfants + activités avec les familles), formation d'auxiliaires de l'enfance, jardins en intérieur d'îlots, etc.

65.label: yes
65.note: This item appears in the contract's list of planned actions ("Les actions suivantes sont envisagées"), and it commits to turning a vacant plot into a new shared green space, which changes vegetation cover.
65.quote: l’aménagement d’un nouvel espace vert collectif sur une friche dans la prolongation du parc de la Petite Senne

66.label: no
66.note: The contract commits to housing, facilities, economic reconversions, socio-economic actions and public-space work for soft mobility and tunnel crossings, but never mentions parks, planting, removing paving or any other greening, and "implanté" only describes where the perimeter lies.

71.label: yes
71.note: Building a green path is one of the actions the programme lists, and a green path changes vegetation cover, so this is a firm plan and not just an aim, even though Bruxelles-Environnement will carry it out.
71.quote: aménager un cheminement vert, le long du tracé de la petite Senne, qui traversa l'intérieur d'îlot du projet phare.

72.label: yes
72.note: The contract puts money ("d'importants moyens sont investis") into creating five pocket parks and the L28A inner-block green space, so it commits to measures that add green cover.
72.quote: l'amélioration du maillage vert avec l'aménagement d'un tronçon de liaison cyclo-piétonne le long de la ligne de chemin de fer L50, la création de 5 'Pocket Park' et l'intérieur d'îlot L28A

74.label: yes
74.note: The contract says in the future tense that a public space will be redesigned and that the design includes creating green zones, which is a commitment to change vegetation cover rather than a general aim.
74.quote: Une attention particulière sera portée à l'aménagement d'un espace public générateur de cohésion sociale, de mobilité douce et innovant sur le plan environnemental (gestion des eaux de pluie, création de zones verdurisées, etc).

75.label: weak
75.note: Green spaces are named only as a potential that the former industrial sites offered, and nothing in the text plans, funds or carries out a change to vegetation cover.
75.quote: qui dessinaient un fort potentiel de création de logements, d'équipements et d'espaces verts

76.label: no
76.note: The sentence only names an existing green space as a site the programme "could rely on", with no planned, funded or firm action to create, redesign, plant or unseal anything.
76.quote: Le CQD pourra notamment s'appuyer sur deux zones stratégiques en termes de redéploiement urbanistique, social, économique et environnemental: le site de l'abbaye, son espace vert et ses abords ainsi qu'une vaste friche urbaine située à proximité de la maison communale.

77.label: yes
77.note: The programme commits to building an extension of a park, which changes vegetation cover; it also plans a shared green space in the Pôle Ysewyn.
77.quote: Le Pôle Rauter permettra l’aménagement d’une extension du parc à l'arrière du Foyer anderlechtois

78.label: yes
78.note: The contract uses firm future wording ("établira") to commit to several public-space works that it describes as a green and blue network, so it plans a change to vegetation cover rather than only stating an aim.
78.quote: établira une « liaison douce » entre la porte de Hal et le parc de Forest, avec différentes interventions sur l’espace public (maillage vert et bleu)

79.label: no
79.note: The contract commits to sports halls, a market hall façade, childcare, housing, and unspecified real-estate and public-space works, but no part of the text mentions planting, parks, removing paving, gardens or green roofs or façades.

80.label: weak
80.note: Nature in the city is listed only as a stated objective ("favoriser la nature en ville"), and the committed items (a local facility, a crèche, renovating the espace Vogler, bike garages) do not include any measure that changes vegetation cover.
80.quote: objectifs affichés d’affirmer le statut de la Place Pogge, d’activer la place Houffalize, de favoriser la nature en ville

86.label: no
86.note: The greening words only describe the existing open green layout of the Peterbos site, and the text commits to no greening measure.
86.quote: avec des dégagements visuels extrêmement généreux et verdurisés

94.label: no
94.note: The programme commits only to a facility, public-space redesign with no mention of vegetation, and socio-economic actions, while every greening word ("contexte verdoyant", "vaste espace vert continu", "corridor de verdure") only describes what already exists.
94.quote: une série d'opérations de réaménagement d'espace public harmonisées par un Master Plan

96.label: no
96.note: This passage only describes the perimeter and the housing that is already there; the marsh and the château grounds appear as place names, and the text plans no park, planting, paving removal or other change to vegetation cover.
96.quote: Il est bordé au Nord par la voie de chemin de fer (L50) qui sépare le quartier du marais de Ganshoren

81.label: weak
81.note: Green spaces appear only as a goal of better access, and redesigning public space is not described as greening, so nothing commits to changing vegetation cover.
81.quote: de requalifier l’espace public et à améliorer l’accessibilité aux espaces verts

82.label: weak
82.note: The contract says only that creating green spaces will be needed; it does not plan, fund or carry out any specific greening measure.
82.quote: Une restructuration de l’espace associée à la création d’espaces publics et d’espaces verts s’avérera donc nécessaire.

87.label: yes
87.note: The contract firmly plans ("prévoit") work on public spaces meant to make them greener, which counts as a commitment to change vegetation cover, not just an aim.
87.quote: Le premier pôle prévoit des interventions dans certains espaces publics afin d’améliorer leur verdurisation, de favoriser les modes de déplacement actifs et de rendre les lieux plus attractifs pour les habitants.

88.label: weak
88.note: Greening appears only as a general aim among the programme's stakes (and the lack of green space and sealed ground as a diagnosis), with no planned, financed or executed intervention that changes vegetation cover.
88.quote: travailler sur la qualité de vie du quartier au sens large : qualité des espaces publics, végétalisés, sécurité routière, etc.

89.label: yes
89.note: The contract commits to turning a street into a "rue parc" (green street), which is a greening measure; it also says the Parc des Résédas "sera lui-même également réaménagé".
89.quote: la Rue Henri Deleers transformée en rue parc entre la Place Bizet et la Rue Walcourt

90.label: yes
90.note: The sentence lists removing paving from and greening the northern public space as part of what the programme will do, alongside housing creation, so it is a planned change to sealed ground and vegetation cover rather than just an aim.
90.quote: le programme visera la création de logements de qualité ainsi que la déminéralisation et verdurisation de l'espace public au nord

91.label: weak
91.note: Greening shows up only as a stated challenge or aim ("il convient de", and elsewhere the conditional "permettrait de créer"), with no planned, funded or scheduled measure that changes vegetation cover.
91.quote: il convient de continuer à aérer et végétaliser la maille et offrir des espaces ouverts qualitatifs aux habitants et usagers du périmètre

92.label: weak
92.note: Creating green spaces is listed only as one of the programme's priorities, which is an aim, and the text names no specific planned, funded or carried-out change to vegetation cover.
92.quote: Priorité 7 : la création d’espaces de jeux et d’espaces verts

93.label: yes
93.note: The programme is organised into axes that group planned operations, and one axis is devoted to a named park, so the contract commits to work on a green space rather than only wishing for one (borderline: the actual works on the park are not described).
93.quote: B. Le parc du Bempt, un espace vert pour le quartier

95.label: no
95.note: The programme mentions public-space projects but never says they will be greened, planted or unpaved, and the other green words are only descriptions or place names ("réserve naturelle du Zavelenberg", "cité jardin", and "implantation", which means siting buildings, not planting), so it commits to no greening measure.
95.quote: Le pôle "socio-économique et participatif" viendra compléter les projets immobiliers et d'espaces publics.
